_readme: Portfolio records and gallery taxonomy. Add a project to 'projects' and its media to 'media'. Filter labels live in 'taxonomy'. Media paths are relative to site.json media.base unless they start with http. rights: 'approved' | 'pending'.

projects.title: Lauryn Koke, Daniel Gale Sotheby's International Realty
projects.client: Lauryn Koke, Daniel Gale Sotheby's International Realty
projects.summary: Listing photography, twilight, aerial coverage and a floor plan for a residential property.
projects.story: A coordinated listing day built around how the home would be marketed: a complete stills set for the room flow and finishes, twilight frames for the launch, aerial context for the setting and a floor plan so buyers understand the layout before they visit.
projects.heroAlt: Arched front entry of the Lloyd Harbor listing, lit at dusk
projects.rightsNote: Client names and media approved for display by James, Sept 23 2026. Outcome claims still need client approval.

projects.title: Property Tour & Agent Media
projects.summary: Property photography and an agent-facing video package captured in one coordinated production day.
projects.story: One production day, two jobs: complete property media for the listing and on-camera pieces the agent can keep using long after the sale.
projects.heroAlt: Modern farmhouse exterior at dusk, Lloyd Harbor

projects.title: Yankee Home Builders
projects.summary: Project photography and an architecture film documenting exterior form and material detail.
projects.story: Coverage planned around the builder's portfolio: the full exterior form, the way the house sits on its site and the material details that show the quality of the build.
projects.heroAlt: Vaulted great room with exposed timber trusses, Amagansett
projects.rightsNote: Approved for display Sept 23 2026. Film needs an MP4 export before it can be shown.

projects.title: Peterson & Ramlowtan
projects.summary: Architecture, interior and exterior photography documenting a finished residence.
projects.story: A finished residence photographed the way the designers think about it: light, proportion and how each space leads to the next.
projects.heroAlt: Walnut kitchen in an East Hampton residence by Peterson & Ramlowtan

projects.title: RevivaLuxe
projects.summary: Brand photography and a brand film for a medical-aesthetics business.
projects.story: Brand stills and a vertical brand film for a medical-aesthetics practice, made to introduce the space and the people clients will meet.
projects.heroAlt: RevivaLuxe founder in the practice reception area

projects.title: Creator Studios Sessions
projects.summary: Podcast and interview production in Creator Studios, with long-form and short-form edits.
projects.story: Multi-camera podcast and interview sessions in our Bohemia studio, with hands-on direction on ideas, pacing and delivery.
projects.heroAlt: Podcast guest recording on set at Creator Studios, Bohemia
